The season began on 8 August 2014 and ended on 18 May 2015.{{cite web |title=جدول الدوري |url=http://www.slstat.com/spl2014-2015ar/champtable.php |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170902171748/http://www.slstat.com/spl2014-2015ar/champtable.php |archive-date=2 September 2017 |url-status=dead}} [[Al-Nassr FC|Al-Nassr]] were the [[2013–14 Saudi Pro League|defending champions]] having won their seventh title the prior season.{{cite web |title=النصر بطلاً لدوري جميل 2014 |url=https://www.alriyadh.com/922240}} The league was contested by the 12 teams from the [[2013–14 Saudi Pro League|2013–14 season]] as well as [[Al-Khaleej FC|Al-Khaleej]] and [[Hajer FC|Hajer]], who joined as the promoted clubs from the [[2013–14 Saudi First Division|2013–14 First Division]]. They replace [[Al-Ettifaq FC|Al-Ettifaq]] and [[Al-Nahda Club (Saudi Arabia)|Al-Nahda]] who were relegated to the [[2014–15 Saudi First Division|2014–15 First Division]]. On 10 May, [[Al-Nassr FC|Al-Nassr]] secured their eighth league title and second one in a row with one game to spare after a 1–0 win against derby rivals [[Al Hilal SFC|Al-Hilal]] coupled with [[Al-Ahli Saudi FC|Al-Ahli]]'s 2–2 draw with [[Al Taawoun FC|Al-Taawoun]].{{cite web |title=النصر بطلاً لدوري جميل 2014 |url=https://www.alriyadh.com/922240}} Runners-up Al-Ahli ended the season without a single defeat becoming the third team to ever do so in a 26-game league season and the fourth team overall. They became the first team to end the season unbeaten and not be crowned champions. Both [[Al-Orobah FC|Al-Orobah]] and [[Al-Shoulla FC|Al-Shoulla]] were relegated on the final matchday on 10 May. Al-Orobah were relegated after a 1–0 home defeat to [[Najran SC|Najran]].{{cite web |title=نجران يوقع على صك هبوط العروبة|url=https://www.alyaum.com/articles/1005172/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%B6%D8%A9/%D9%86%D8%AC%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86-%D9%8A%D9%88%D9%82%D8%B9-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%B5%D9%83-%D9%87%D8%A8%D9%88%D8%B7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%A8%D8%A9}} Al-Shoulla were relegated after a 2–2 draw with [[Al Raed FC|Al-Raed]].{{cite web |title=النصر يحسم "الدربي" بهدف "مشبوه" ويحتفظ بلقب الدوري السعودي |url=https://alwasat.ly/news/sports/69249}} ==Teams== Fourteen teams competed in the league – the twelve teams from the previous season and the two teams promoted from the [[2013–14 Saudi First Division|First Division]]. The promoted teams were [[Hajer FC|Hajer]] (returning after a season's absence) and [[Al-Khaleej FC|Al-Khaleej]] (returning to the top flight after seven years). They replaced [[Al-Ettifaq FC|Al-Ettifaq]] (ending their thirty-seven-year top-flight spell) and [[Al-Nahda Club (Saudi Arabia)|Al-Nahda]] (who were relegated after one season in the top flight). ===Stadiums and locations=== {{Location map+ |Saudi Arabia |width=440 |float=right |caption=Locations of teams in the 2014–15 Saudi Professional League |places= {{Location map~ |Saudi Arabia |lat=21.54333 |long=39.17278 |label=[[Al-Ahli Saudi FC|Al-Ahli]]
